The processor calls the Bedrock image model, stores the PNG, and flips the job row to complete; the UI gallery then reads it with a presigned URL." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="500" x="50" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g9" parent="region" style="whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#5A6C86;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 8;verticalAlign=top;align=center;fontSize=12;fontColor=#5A6C86;container=1;dropTarget=1;" value="Observability & Access" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="250" x="50" y="845" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cw" parent="g9" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=12;fontStyle=0;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.cloudwatch_2" value="Amazon CloudWatch<br>logs · metrics · traces" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="78" width="78" x="66" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="iam" parent="g9" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#DD344C;strokeColor=none;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=12;fontStyle=0;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.role" value="IAM roles<br>per-runtime · gateway · Cognito" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="78" width="78" x="66" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flowpanel" parent="region" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#B0B7C3;fontSize=11;spacing=8;fontColor=#232F3E;" value="<b>Numbered flow</b><br>&#9312; Browser loads the Angular app through CloudFront (WAF-protected).<br>&#9313; CloudFront reads the private S3 UI bucket via Origin Access Control.<br>&#9314; User signs in to the Cognito User Pool; the Identity Pool returns scoped temporary credentials.<br>&#9315; The SPA calls InvokeAgentRuntime (SigV4) on the AgentCore Runtime.<br>&#9316; The runtime loads instructions, agent cards and global config from DynamoDB.<br>&#9317; Agents reason with Claude on Amazon Bedrock.<br>&#9318; Session context is written to and read from AgentCore Memory.<br>&#9319; Tool calls go through the AgentCore Gateway over MCP to Lambda targets.<br>&#9320; RAG queries hit the Bedrock knowledge base backed by OpenSearch Serverless.<br>&#9321; AgencyAgent invokes the AAMP buyer and seller runtimes over A2A JSON-RPC.<br>&#9322; Creative requests fan out to the asynchronous image pipeline.<br>&#9323; Voice runs browser-to-Bedrock: a bidirectional Nova 2 Sonic stream." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="500" x="1650" y="845" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Numbered flow
① Browser loads the Angular app through CloudFront (WAF-protected).
② CloudFront reads the private S3 UI bucket via Origin Access Control.
③ User signs in to the Cognito User Pool; the Identity Pool returns scoped temporary credentials.
④ The SPA calls InvokeAgentRuntime (SigV4) on the AgentCore Runtime.
⑤ The runtime loads instructions, agent cards and global config from DynamoDB.
⑥ Agents reason with Claude on Amazon Bedrock.
⑦ Session context is written to and read from AgentCore Memory.
⑧ Tool calls go through the AgentCore Gateway over MCP to Lambda targets.
⑨ RAG queries hit the Bedrock knowledge base backed by OpenSearch Serverless.
⑩ AgencyAgent invokes the AAMP buyer and seller runtimes over A2A JSON-RPC.
⑪ Creative requests fan out to the asynchronous image pipeline.
⑫ Voice runs browser-to-Bedrock: a bidirectional Nova 2 Sonic stream.
